# DiffuEraser

Inference sources from [DiffuEraser](https://github.com/lixiaowen-xw/DiffuEraser),
by Xiaowen Li, Haolan Xue, Peiran Ren, and Liefeng Bo.

This copy includes temporal-window batching, batched VAE decoding, and frame
storage integration. It uses the setup in [data/README.md](../../README.md)
and weights in [weights/README.md](../../weights/README.md).

See [LICENSE](LICENSE) and [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
